thread:
incidents-bot: ALERT: High request rate detected on /v1/embeddings (edge-eu-west). 95th p95 latency spike, request rate x12 above baseline. Possible automated probing. dashboard: https://grafana.internal/r/edge-embeds?panel=3
oncall-olivia: I'm paged, looking. Do we have a top-src/IP/ASN breakdown yet?
eng-sre-max: Seen repeated identical user-agent patterns + small payloads. Likely scraper. Top ASN looks like AS12345 (hosting farm). Sending quick query now.
edge-alex: K/V: can we apply a temporary geo-slice to EU and APAC for embeddings? Suggest 30% quota slice to paid tier, drop anonymous/free to 10r/min.
oncall-olivia: Yes, do it. Apply rate-slice and enable WAF challenge for suspicious signatures. 
security-nia: Confirmed credential-probing pattern on the same IPs as the embed hits; they are likely recycling proxy pool. Recommend WAF block on the IP set + captcha challenge on UI endpoints. For API, prefer quota-slicing first to avoid killing legit traffic.
eng-sre-max: Pushing a dynamic quota change now: route policy `embeddings.edge.euw` -> quota tiers: paid=70%, free=10%, reserve=20%. Command: `curl -XPOST https://controlplane/api/policy -d '{"route":"embeddings.edge.euw","quota_slices":{"paid":0.7,"free":0.1}}'`
edge-alex: Applied rate slices, propagation ~15s. Also turned on WAF rule set id 318 for ASN fingerprinting. Watching errors.
oncall-olivia: Noted. Any immediate customer-facing failures? product-lina: Support queue shows 6 tickets mentioning timeouts for embed requests in EU over last 10m. Severity: medium. Customers mainly on free tier or eval accounts.
support-raj: I'm triaging those 6, sending status update to each: "We're seeing abnormal traffic and have enacted temporary rate limits to stabilize the service. We'll follow up with more details"
security-nia: WAF blocks starting to take effect, malicious IPs dropping. However, we see fallback attempts via different proxies every 45-60s. Recommend enabling aggressive client token fingerprinting + short-lived ban (10m) for repeat offenders.
oncall-olivia: Agree. Max, can you engage token-ban rule?
eng-sre-max: Implemented token ban rule: if token shows >50 failed-ish embed requests in 5m from >5 ASNs, auto-ban for 10m. Deployed to edge. Rule log: `ban_rule:TB-21`
edge-alex: Also toggled adaptive connection shaping: prioritize requests with auth.tier==paid, deprioritize anon by 80% concurrency. That should reduce noise on GPUs.
product-lina: Heads up: some SMB customers on paid tier reported slight latency increase. Impact limited but visible. We'll prepare a short status note if this persists.
support-raj: Customers notified. No escalations yet.
security-nia: Seeing reduced probe amplitude (-70% in malformed embed patterns) after token bans + WAF. Good signal.
oncall-olivia: Good. I'll stay on for 30m then hand off. Ryan, are you available for a 3-way Handoff in 20m?
oncall-ryan: I'm on standby, can take in 20.
eng-sre-max: Quick follow-up: enabled KV-prefix caching on frequent legit prefixes to lower cost under degraded throughput. Patch: `cache.policy.add("embeds-prefix", ttl=60)`
edge-alex: Cache applied to 120 edge nodes. Should reduce load within 2 minutes.
product-lina: Recommend we hold off broad customer email; wait for stable metrics and then send a post-incident summary.
security-nia: Suggest we capture full IP lists + ASN fingerprints and hand to fraud team for long-term blocking. I'll export logs to /secure/incidents/1749954321/probes.log.gz
oncall-olivia: Timeline so far: 0m alert -> 2m rate-slice -> 4m WAF toggle -> 8m token-ban rule -> 12m adaptive shaping -> 18m KV cache. Looks stable, error rate down by 60% and p95 latency trending down.
oncall-olivia: I'm handing off to oncall-ryan at 1749954600 for continued monitoring and cleanup. Ryan, please monitor for 2 hours and coordinate with security for final mitigations.
oncall-ryan: taking over. I'll monitor dashboards and follow up on any customer escalations.
support-raj: I'll reopen any tickets if we see new customer impact.
eng-sre-max: After-action items: 1) expand WAF ASN rules, 2) tune token-ban thresholds, 3) add probe detection to canary tests. Filing infra ticket INF-5643.
security-nia: I'll start a post-mortem doc and include indicators of compromise.
product-lina: Thanks all. Please add brief notes to the incident doc so we can consider product mitigations for free-tier abuse.
oncall-ryan: Acknowledged. Closing active mitigation plan at 1749954680 — will reopen if metrics worsen.
